Page 47 Cont.
Aug. 23 Anna Larkin of Chicago - 73 - Very serious cancer condition.
24 Mrs. Richards about 50 - Heart and Kidney ... Feet Swolen.
Masie Wright - 22 -
Rose Pepka - 22 - vocation unappreciated. .. losing
....
25 Caroline Kubitzke - 45 - trying hard to sell property .... fears los- ing it ...
Mrs. Minnie Stratman - 57 - threatened with goitre operation - was enrolled in Ser. Masses - goitre gone but otherwise not very well ... John Stratman - 65 - Fractured Skull .... unconscious since last Fri- day.
Page 48
Aug. 26 James D. Young - 5 - Lutheran - water on brain - seems bright enough remarkably so for in such condition. Then too his feet are very weak - cannot walk. Enrolled To-day for year.
27 Mrs. Mary Kilcain - 73 - Springfield - nervous break.
28 Mary Bovine - 19 - threatening sist on breast, promises more fre- quent Communion if Operation is favorable.
29 Wm. Bode - 23 Lukemia - 2468 Canton
Wm. Gravier - 55 - of Wyandotte, fearful condition of Skin 5 yrs straight in hospital; often feels desperate .. Enrolled To-day 2.00
Irene O'Leary - 6 - fell 22 yrs ago ... neck partly out of joint - is improving for sometime but cannot speak as yet.
30 Julia Goskowski - 38 - hands peculiarly infected; can do 0
31 Mrs. Nellie Harty - Widow 56 - to have Eye removed To-day at 2 P.M. Enrolls in Ser. Mass ... As'n.
Purse left in Church
RE
